falsified_assumptions: PR/ref cancelling + newest-commit-only classification can erase an unmet evidence obligation when a relevant queued classifier is superseded by a later irrelevant commit before admission.

The topology checker currently ratchets that scheduling shape, while the normative split-custody document already states that cancellation is safe only if the newer classifier cannot erase an unmet obligation.

The authoritative-v2 classifier reinterprets release fingerprint globs with fnmatch.fnmatchcase even though the release fingerprint uses glob.glob(..., recursive=true). All 15 current fingerprint patterns containing recursive **/* have a direct-child zero-directory witness that recursive glob matches and fnmatch misses.
required_invariants: Classifier-only green is routing evidence, never satisfaction.
A semantic evidence obligation remains fail-closed until a substantive result is durably admitted or satisfied.
A later irrelevant commit may not erase an earlier unmet obligation.
Classifier impact must reuse the owning evidence/fingerprint semantics rather than maintain a second glob interpretation.
Any satisfaction mechanism must bind the semantic evidence fingerprint and provenance of the substantive result.
